testcase.name: Scenario: Activate an already open part through the Open dialog: scenario/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:122:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Activate an already open part through the Open dialog ✔ Given a saved part is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a different drawing document is active ✔ And the open part's exact file location is known ✔ When the user presses Control+O and chooses the already open part at that location ✔ And the user chooses Open ✔ Then the Open dialog closes ✔ And the existing part document tab becomes active ✔ And no additional document tab is created ✔ And the drawing tab remains available
